goal: Allow users to manually rebroadcast unconfirmed wallet transactions via RPC or the GUI
Eliminates the need to extract raw transaction hex and call sendrawtransaction when transactions drop
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile with nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Broad concept support for giving users manual rebroadcast controls
Useful in all scenarios regardless of ultimate rebroadcast solution (mzumsande)
Approach approval with interface suggestions addressed (vasild)
Unaddressed objection: fails with empty error when feerate exceeds -maxfeerate (fametrano)
Concept approval without stated reasons (polespinasa, murchandamus, jpk68)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it solves an acknowledged usability pain point for users with stuck transactions
Users can directly retry propagation without manually extracting and submitting raw hex
